citation.title: The measurement of carbon density profile using charge exchange spectroscopy in KSTAR
citation.authors: J. K. Lee, H. H. Lee, W. H. Ko, B. Na, J. Ko, M. W. Lee, S. G. Lee

topic: KSTAR CES (C VI 529.05 nm, NBI-1) C6+ density profiles; methodology and RMP-ELM-suppression case
own_question: Can absolute C6+ density profiles be obtained from KSTAR CES using ADAS CX rates and a KSTAR-adapted beam penetration code, and how do they evolve under RMPs?
actual_method_and_evidence: Absolute intensity calibration with a halogen source; ADAS effective CX rates for n=1 and n=2; KSTARBEAM beam densities; Zeff assumed 2, with a sensitivity scan over 2-4. Active spectrum obtained by beam-modulation background subtraction and a single-Gaussian fit. Ti and V_T errors come from the fitted width and shift; density errors are statistical intensity errors only. Results come from one discharge (26421), with profiles at 4.3, 5.9, 6.8 and 7.6 s. Text-only source; figures not checked.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR CES infers C6+ (impurity) temperature and toroidal rotation from Doppler broadening and shift of the C VI n=8-7 CX line driven by NBI-1. The C6+ temperature is treated as approximately the main-ion temperature.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.3 Sec. II; p.4-5 Sec. III E
claim_checks.qualification: The Ti equality is the authors' equilibration argument, not a measurement. Labels are conventional fitted reports, not independent truth.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: KSTAR CES uses beam modulation to subtract passive and edge background before the active-CX fit. This links reported values to beam-on/off timing.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.3-4 Sec. II; p.5 Fig. 5 caption
claim_checks.qualification: No report cadence, latency or arrival time is given. The real-time two-Gaussian approach is cited as future work, not demonstrated here.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: No CES integration time, report cadence or latency is stated. Analysis is offline; real-time density measurement is only proposed.
validation_if_relevant: Single discharge. The Zeff sensitivity scan is not independent validation. No uncertainty on beam density is propagated.
forbidden_inferences: CES reports are real-time or have known latency
C6+ temperature equals main-ion temperature as measured fact
results generalize to 2022 campaign or our chord
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Useful KSTAR-specific background on how CES impurity temperature reports are produced: line choice, beam modulation and Gaussian-fit uncertainty. It is not about temperature nowcasting and gives no timing information.
